description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application using React Native, configuring the main component, React architecture settings, and handling device configuration changes and back button behavior.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity of the Android app extending ReactActivity, managing React Native integration, app configuration, and system interactions.

methods.name: getMainComponentName
methods.description: Returns the name of the main React Native component to be rendered, which is 'StandardNotes'.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overrides the activity's onCreate method, calling super with null to initialize React Native.

methods.name: createReactActivityDelegate
methods.description: Creates and returns a ReactActivityDelegate with custom parameters for React Native architecture features like Fabric and Concurrent React.

methods.name: onConfigurationChanged
methods.description: Handles configuration changes (like theme changes), forwarding them to React Native's instance manager.

methods.name: invokeDefaultOnBackPressed
methods.description: Overrides the back button behavior to move the app to the background instead of quitting.
